name: SearchTemplatesWithFilter
query:
query SearchTemplatesWithFilter($filter: QueryTemplatesFilter, $pagination: PaginationInput, $sort: [TemplateSortInput!]) {
  searchTemplates(filter: $filter, pagination: $pagination, sort: $sort) {
    id
    identifier
    name
    description
    tags
    operationType
    complexityScore
    usageCount
    avgExecutionTimeMs
    isActive
    createdAt
  }
}
